#  11165 - Design Project in Cooperation with Additional Urban Design Module Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11165 - module is no longer offered from WS 2016/17**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Design Project in Cooperation with Additional Urban Design Module**  |  
|  Entwurfsprojekt in Kooperation mit zusätzlichem Modul Städtebau   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Huckriede, Bernd 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | At the end of the module the student are able to plan social and public buildings and to use methodical, experimental and investigative know-how equivalent to the professional activities of architects according to the level of third year studies.  |  
| Contents:  | The content of this course takes the form of a design project that deals with examples of building in urban context and existing structures, with developing complex forms of buildings in hybrid situations.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Design project / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 150 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Specific compilations of relevant literature will be available during the semester in the university library.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  Design Project. Basic teaching methods are tutored sessions in the studio and public presentations in front of the group. Students develop the design for a project according to the basic topics of the architectural discipline in social, scientific, methodical and artistic aspects. Design development and presentation of the project should be done with CAD.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Working in the studio (atelier) is necessary. This design project is in cooperation with the urban design module no 24301.  |  
| Module Components:  | -  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
